name: Toronto Water Budget and Capital Plan
known_limitations: Adopted budgets and capital plans establish authorized funding, project categories, and planned cash flows. They do not prove procurement, construction, project delivery, local hydraulic capacity, or a service commitment for a named development.
automation_notes: Track the adopted annual budget, detailed capital plan, delivery constraints, material reallocations, and named project procurement or completion records.
